<entry id="D00313">
<head-word>דּוֹפָן, </head-word>
<head-word>דֹּפָן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (דפן, v. 
<xref rid="D00952">דַּף</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>board-partition</italic>, esp. a wall of the festive booth (סוּכָּה).</definition>
<notes> Succ. 4
<sup>a</sup> ד' האמצעי the middle of the three walls. Ib. ד' עקומה 
<italic>the curved wall</italic>, a legal fiction by which a part of the ceiling may be considered as part of a curved wall.—Ib. 6
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (trnsf.) 
<italic>side</italic> of a vessel, oppos.</definition>
<notes> to bottom, rim &c. Ohol. IX, 16 תחת דָּפְנָהּ under the belly of its side; Tosef. ib. X, 9 דּוֹפְנָהּ. Ib. VII, 10 side of a cave, opp. to שקוף &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the chest surrounding the lungs, ribs</italic>, also 
<italic>a single rib</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 48
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. ריאה הסמוכה לד' lungs adhering to the chest. Snh. 49
<sup>a</sup> ד' חמישית the fifth rib (counting from the lowest).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the paries of the abdomen</italic>.</definition>
<notes> יוצא ד' a fetus extracted by means of 
<italic>the cesarean section</italic>. Nidd. V, 1; a. fr.—Metaph. תלה בד' to suspend from the wall, i.e. 
<italic>to leave a decision in suspense</italic>. Y. Kidd. IV, 65
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Y. Snh. VI, 23
<sup>c</sup> bot. בריפן (corr. acc.).—
<plural-form>Pl. דּוֹפַנִּים,</plural-form> constr. דּוֹפַנֵּי; mostly דְּפַנּוֹת. Ḥull. 45
<sup>b</sup> דופני ריאה 
<italic>the grooves between the lungs</italic>, דפנות 
<italic>ribs</italic>. Ib.
<sup>a</sup> שתי ד' two sides of the chest.—Succ. I, 1; a. fr.—Tosef. Ohol. VI, 2 בצד דּוֹפְנִי וכ' ed. Zuck. on the 
<italic>wall-like</italic> side of the tent. Ib. עם דופני של אוהל, ed. Zuck., read (with R. S. to Ohol. V, 7) רפנות or (with ed.) דּוֹפְנוֹ.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00323">
<head-word>דּוּץ, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (contr. of דְּעַץ) 
<italic>to prick, stick, squeeze</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 50
<sup>b</sup> דָּצָהּ שלפה וכ' if he stuck it in, pulled it out &c.—Ib. 156
<sup>b</sup> דָּצְתָהּ בגודא (Ms. O. דעיצתא בביזעא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) she stuck it (the brooch) into the wall. Ḥull. 93
<sup>b</sup> אי דָץ ביה מידי if he stuck something into the nostrils (so as to keep them open). Succ. 37
<sup>b</sup> לא לֵדוּץ וכ' one must not squeeze the palm branch between the myrtle and willow (after they have been tied together). [B. Bath. 74
<sup>a</sup> דצייה Ar., v. דְּעַץ.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00325">
<head-word>דּוּק</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. דוּךְ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pound, beat; to powder</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 14
<sup>a</sup>, v. דּיּךְ.—Part. Peil דָּיִיק 
<italic>powdered</italic>. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> ד' טפי fine-powdered. Ḥull. 51
<sup>b</sup>, v. כִּיתְנָא, V. דְּקַק.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. בִּין, בָּקַר a. oth.) 
<italic>to examine carefully, to be particular, exact in expression; to pay special attention, to mind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 6
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. דָּק ואשכח he examined and found. Succ. 8
<sup>a</sup> לא דק he did not express himself exactly; a. fr.—
<italic>Part.</italic> דָּיֵיק 
<italic>careful</italic>. Keth. 18
<sup>b</sup> מֵידַק ד' he is very careful (as to what witnesses he uses). Yoma 83
<sup>b</sup> הווה ד' בשמא minded a man’s name (considering it an indication of his character). Ib. לא הוו דַיְיקֵי בשמא did not mind &c. Ib. דַּיְיקִיתוּ ye mind.—Part. Peil דָּיִיק (v. 
<italic>Pa</italic>.) 
<italic>proved, conclusive</italic>. B. Kam. 3
<sup>b</sup> those verses לא כמר דָּיְיקֵי וכ' are no evidence either for the one or the other.—Denom. דֵּיקָא, דְּיוּקָא, דּוְקָא.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>דַּיֵּיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to grind, to chew carefully</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 155
<sup>a</sup> bot. דדֵיְּיקָה ואכלה Ms. M. (ed. דדיקה באוכלא) she grinds her food carefully.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to argue by pressing a word, to analyze, prove</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 31
<sup>b</sup> ד' מרישא takes his argument from the first clause; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to calculate exactly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. XXVII, 18. Ib. XXV, 50, v. דִּקְדֵק; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אוֹדִיק, אֲדִיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be punctilious, get impatient</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to III, 9 א' מלכא the king was irritated. Pesik. B’shall. 
<pgbrk id="pg288" />p. 86
<sup>b</sup>; Yalk. Sam. 152 אוֹדִיקַת סרח וכ' Serah … grew 
<italic>angry</italic>
<italic>;</italic> cmp. דִּקְדֵּק.—2) 
<italic>to examine, look with anxiety, wait attentively</italic>. Targ. Prov. VII, 6. Targ. Ps. XIV, 2; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 17 אודיק … לקלהון R. … examined into the noise they made; Lev. R. s. 34; Yalk. Lev. 665; Yalk. Is. 352. Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> top; Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> top א' לון תכ' Bar K. looked out for them (waiting for them to ask him).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="D00326">
<head-word>דַּוְקָא, </head-word>
<head-word>דַּוְוקָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>exactness, minuteness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nez. 7
<sup>b</sup> נחית לד' enters into minuteness (saying ‘one and a half’).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (as an adv.) 
<italic>exactly, exclusively, only</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 76
<sup>a</sup> ד' שערתא a real barley corn it must be (nothing else). Men. 30
<sup>a</sup> באמצע שיטה ד' only in the middle of a line.—Gitt. 44
<sup>a</sup> ד' או לאו ד' is this meant exactly (one hundred), or not exactly? Men. 27
<sup>b</sup> אל ד' 
<italic>el</italic> (towards) is meant in its exact sense; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<italic>calculating, accurate scholar</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> משום דמסיימי בה ד' זו וכ' because exact scholars report a traditional addition (to the Halachah in question), ‘These are the words of R. S.’</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00339">
<head-word>דּוֹקְרָן, </head-word>
<head-word>דַּקְרָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key> h. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>fork, fork-like reed, pronged pole</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Erub. I, 18
<sup>c</sup> קנה וד' reed-stem and prongs. Ib. 19
<sup>c</sup> כמין דק'; Y. Kil. IV, 29
<sup>b</sup> כמין דוק'; Y. Succ. I, 52
<sup>a</sup> bot. כמין דְּקָרִים (v. דֶּקֶר). Y. Shebi. II, 33
<sup>d</sup> top עושה לה דיק' (corr. acc.) he puts under it a pronged prop. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 14 הדוק' ed. Zuck. (Var. דורקין).—
<plural-form>Pl. דּוֹקְרָנִים, דּוֹקְרָנִין, דָּק'</plural-form>. Y. Kil. l. c. he took דוק' וסותם forked reeds with which he closed the breach; Y. Erub. I, 19
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Succ. l. c.—Tosef. ib. I, 4 if one made a ceiling of the Succah בקנים ובד' with (plain) reeds and with forked reeds; Bab. ib. 13
<sup>a</sup> קנים וד' (Ms. M. 2 קנים הד', v. Ar. s. v. דקר), expl. קנים של ד' pronged reeds. Tosef. Men. XI, 6 דומין לדק' shaped like forks; Men. XI, 6 (96
<sup>a</sup>) מפוצלין … כמין ד' Ar. (ed. omit. כמין ד').—*Denom. מְדוּקְרָן 
<italic>fork-shaped</italic>. Tosef. Kil. IV, 5 קנים מְדוּקְרָנִים; Erub. 16
<sup>a</sup>; 11
<sup>b</sup> קנים הדוקרנין (Ms. M. הדוקרים).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00341">
<head-word>דּוּר</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.)</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>[1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to form a circle or enclosure</italic> (v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, p. 440
<sup>a</sup> sq.</definition>
<notes>).—Denom. דּוּר II, דּוֹר, דִּירָה &c.].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of דִּירָה) 
<italic>to reside, dwell</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 8
<sup>a</sup> לעולם יָדוֹר וכ' one must try to live in the same place with his teacher. Keth. 72
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr. אין אדם דָּר וכ', v. כְּפִיפָה. Ib. 110
<sup>b</sup> בל הדָּר בא"י whoever lives in Palestine.—Succ. 35
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to 
<italic>hadar</italic>, Lev. XXIII, 40) א"ת הָדָר אלא הַדָּר דבר שֶדָּר וכ' ed. (Ms. M. הָדָר דבר הַדָּר וכ') read not 
<italic>hadar</italic> but 
<italic>haddar</italic>, something which remains on its tree from year to year (without withering); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lodge</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>דִּיֵּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause a circuit;</italic> ד' שדה 
<italic>to let cattle change folds within a field, to collect manure in a field, by letting cattle live on it.</italic></definition>
<notes> Shebi. III, 4. Y. ib. 34
<sup>c</sup> bot. מְדַיְּירִין בטובה you may let your cattle live on one’s field as a favor; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lodge</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵדִיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to lodge</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 3, beg. (play on דָּֽ֗רְ֗בָ֗ן֗) שמֵדִ֗יר̇ ב̇ינ̇ה בפרה it (the goad) causes understanding to dwell in the cow; Pesik Baḥod. p. 153
<sup>a</sup> שמורה (ed. O. שמדיר); Koh. R. to XII, 11 [read:] שהוא מְדַיֵּיר; Num. R. s. 14 שדָּר; Y. Snh. Tanḥ. B’haăl 15 דָּר אצל הפרה וכ'.—[Num. R. l. c. the words of the wise דָּ֗רִ֗ים ב̇ינ̇ה וכ' lodge understanding with men.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִדּיָּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be manured</italic> by cattle living in folds, v. Piel.</definition>
<notes> Shebi. IV, 2; M. Kat. 13
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="D00342">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to dwell</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CV, 23; a. fr.—Pes. 113
<sup>a</sup> top (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6).—Part. דָּאִיר, דָּיֵיר. Targ. Ps. LVII, 5 דָיְירָא Ms. (ed. חיירא).—Yeb. 52
<sup>a</sup> דאיר בבי וכ' he resides with his father-in-law. B. Mets. 117
<sup>a</sup> דהוו דָיְירֵי who occupied. Taan. 24
<sup>a</sup> דָּיִירְנָא וכ' I live in a poor village.</notes></sense></senses>
<pgbrk id="pg289" />
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>דַּוַּור, דַּוַּאר, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, דַּיֵּיר </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go around, to peddle</italic> (cmp. h. סָחַר).</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 9
<sup>b</sup> (expl. דְּרוֹר, Lev. XXV, 10) כמְדַיֵּיר דיירא ומוביל וכ' Ms. M. (ed. בי דיירא, Ar. s. v. דר 3: כי מדַוַּאר דריא) as a traveller is licensed to go around and carry his goods through the whole district.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to deposit manure</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="D00341">preced.</xref>
<italic>Pi</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—B. Kam. 113
<sup>b</sup> הני דדַיְּירֵי דירי Rashi (ed. דרי, Ms. R. דמְדַיְּירֵי דיירי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) those (gentiles) who manure fields for pay by letting cattle live on them in folds.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to place around</italic> (
<italic>in a row</italic>, Rashi).</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 81
<sup>a</sup> ד' גולפי placed jugs around (as a partition).—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to round a person, to overtake</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 92
<sup>b</sup>; B. Mets. 107
<sup>b</sup> (prov.) רהוט … ולא דַּוְּורוּהוּ וכ' Ar. (ed. מטו, אמטו) runners run but overtake not one who has taken a morning meal.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="D00345">
<head-word>דּוֹר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.,</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="D00342"> דּוּר I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>circle, period</italic>, cmp. גִּיל] 
<italic>generation, contemporaries</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. 17
<sup>a</sup> ד' לפי פרנס as the leader so the generation; a. v. fr.—ד' הפלגה the generation which witnessed the separation of races; ד' המבול which perished in the flood; ד' המדבר which perished in the desert, &c. Snh. X, 3 (107
<sup>b</sup>, sq.); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. דּוֹרוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. 99
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—לַדּוֹרוֹת 
<italic>for all time to come; permanent</italic>, opp. לשעה, הוראת שעה a temporary ordinance. Ib. 16
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Num. VII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> אותם במשיחה ולא לד' וכ' only they were installed with ointment, but not as a precedent for future installations; a. fr.—Men. 19
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. ד' משעה לא ילפינן a permanent law cannot be derived from a special temporary legislation.—פסח ד' annual Passover celebration, opp. to פסח מצרים the one observed in Epypt. Pes. IX, 5; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>d</sup> bot. דָּחִינוּ אותו וכ' we postponed it (the fast) to the first day of the week; Meg. 5
<sup>b</sup> דְחִינוּהוּ; Erub. 41
<sup>a</sup> דְחִינֻהוּ.—Pes. VI, 1 אלו דברים … דוחין וכ' the following performances needed for the Passover offering take precedence of the Sabbath (cause a suspension of the Sabbath laws); a. v. fr.—

<italic>pushed, hurried</italic>. M. Kat. 28
<sup>a</sup> מיתה דְחוּיָה a hurried death.—b) 
<italic>suspended, superseded</italic>. Yoma 7
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. טומאה דְּחוּיָה היא וכ' the law about levitical purity is only suspended for the sake of an entire community (and its suspension requires atonement), opp. טומאה הותרה the law &c. is inoperative. Zeb. 12
<sup>a</sup> ד' מעיקרו unfit from the start, opp. נראה ונדחה, v. infra.—[Yeb. 80
<sup>b</sup>; Gitt. 57
<sup>a</sup> דוחה, v. דִּיהַּ.]</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

<sup>a</sup> בעלי חיים אינן נידחין animals (dedicated for sacrifices) cannot be removed forever from sacred use (as long as the obstacle lies not in their physical unfitness). Ib. נראה ונ' once fit and then discarded (on account of a temporary unfitness).—Ber. 64
<sup>a</sup> כל הנ' … שעה נִדֶּחֶת מפניו to him who gives way to time (yielding patiently to circumstances), time will give way, v. דָּחַק.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
